description.value: Bear Lodge is a fully-equipped condo-style property situated on Whistler Village Stroll, steps from the Whistler Mountain Gondolas and the Marketplace Centre. Units come with full kitchens, in-suite washer/dryer, and some offer private balconies and wood-burning fireplaces. Its central Village location puts a wide range of dining, shopping, and nightlife immediately outside the door.
